name: Floria
source:
A womanizing siren that immediately begins hitting on Kanata. He explains that, even though he is a siren, he does not sing. Floria keeps the secret behind his refusal to sing buried within himself.

[Summarized from [url=http://breadmasterlee.wordpress.com/2009/06/07/otome-game-review-love-drops/]Hinano's review[/url].]
